history.summary: NOT A HINDU TEMPLE — keep-or-drop decision needed. Sakchi Gurudwara is a Sikh gurdwara at 11/329 New Kalimati Road, Kasidih, Sakchi, Jamshedpur (831001), set down as tradition 'Sikhism' accordingly. It is a white-stone domed building described by one video source as resembling the Taj Mahal in structure (single source, verify), about 2.2 km from the Golchakkar bus stand, and is rated 4.5/5 (121 ratings) on Justdial. Local Sikh news coverage shows it hosting Baisakhi/Khalsa-day celebrations and kirtan darbars for Guru Gobind Singh's Prakash Parv. No published account of its founding, history or managing committee's origins could be found.
